tv_wonder_location_has_sacred_mountain_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_sacred_mountain_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_sacred_mountain_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_sacred_mountain_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_sacred_mountain_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_sacred_mountain_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|2)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_military_city value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_military_city value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 2 } }
				}

				}
			}

		AND = {

			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_civic_capital value >= 2 } }
			OR = {

				}
			}
		}
		AND = {

			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_civic_capital value >= 3 } }

tv_wonder_location_has_triumphal_axis_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_triumphal_axis_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_triumphal_axis_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_triumphal_axis_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_triumphal_axis_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_triumphal_axis_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_great_port_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_port
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_port_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_port_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_port_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_port_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_great_port_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_trade_port
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_imperial_naval_port
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_free_trade_metropolis
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_great_port_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_port
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_port_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_port_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_port_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_port_decoration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_trade_port
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_imperial_naval_port
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_free_trade_metropolis
	}
}

	tv_wonder_location_has_great_port_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_great_port_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_great_port_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_great_port_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_great_port_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_giant_necropolis_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_necropolis
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_necropolis_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_necropolis_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_necropolis_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_necropolis_decoration
	}
}

	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_dynastic_necropolis
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_ancestor_shrine
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_quiet_land

			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_dynastic_necropolis value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 4 } }

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|4)" ?= { this >= 3 }

tv_wonder_location_has_giant_necropolis_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_giant_necropolis_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_giant_necropolis_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_giant_necropolis_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_giant_necropolis_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_giant_necropolis_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_great_lighthouse_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_lighthouse
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_lighthouse_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_lighthouse_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_lighthouse_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_lighthouse_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_great_lighthouse_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_eternal_lighthouse
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_navigator_lighthouse
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_long_watch_lighthouse
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_great_lighthouse_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_lighthouse
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_lighthouse_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_lighthouse_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_lighthouse_function

		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_navigator_lighthouse

			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_long_watch_lighthouse value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_long_watch_lighthouse value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 5 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 5 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|5)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_long_watch_lighthouse value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_long_watch_lighthouse value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 5 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 5 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|5)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_great_lighthouse_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_great_lighthouse_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_great_lighthouse_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_great_lighthouse_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_great_lighthouse_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_great_lighthouse_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_hydraulic_workshop_intermediate_building_trigger = {

		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_hydraulic_workshop_decoration
	}

tv_wonder_location_has_hydraulic_workshop_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_water_god_workshop

	OR = {
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_water_god_workshop value >= 1 }

				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier

				}

		always = yes

	trigger_else = { always = no }

			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_mint_city value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_mint_city value >= 3 } }
			OR = {

				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 7 } }

tv_wonder_location_has_mining_city_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_mining_city_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_mining_city_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_mining_city_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_mining_city_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_mining_city_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_giant_observatory_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_observatory
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_observatory_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_observatory_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_observatory_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_observatory_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_giant_observatory_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_star_catalog_observatory
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_nautical_almanac_observatory
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_eclipse_observatory
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_giant_observatory_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_observatory
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_observatory_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_observatory_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_observatory_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_observatory_decoration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_star_catalog_observatory
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_nautical_almanac_observatory
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_eclipse_observatory
	}
}

		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_palace_of_nations_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_congress_palace
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_tribute_gallery
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_embassy_palace
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_palace_of_nations_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_palace_of_nations
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_palace_of_nations_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_palace_of_nations_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_palace_of_nations_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_palace_of_nations_decoration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_congress_palace
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_tribute_gallery
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_embassy_palace
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_palace_of_nations_expandable_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_congress_palace value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_congress_palace value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 9 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 9 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|9)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_congress_palace value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_congress_palace value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 9 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 9 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|9)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_congress_palace value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_congress_palace value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 9 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 9 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|9)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_congress_palace value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_congress_palace value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 9 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 9 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|9)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_congress_palace value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_congress_palace value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 9 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 9 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|9)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_tribute_gallery value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_tribute_gallery value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 9 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 9 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|9)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_tribute_gallery value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_tribute_gallery value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 9 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 9 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|9)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_tribute_gallery value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_tribute_gallery value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 9 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 9 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|9)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_tribute_gallery value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_tribute_gallery value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 9 } }

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|9)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_tribute_gallery value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_tribute_gallery value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 9 } }
				}
				AND = {

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|9)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}

			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_embassy_palace value >= 1 }

					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 9 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 9 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|9)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}

		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_embassy_palace value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_embassy_palace value >= 3 } }

tv_wonder_location_has_palace_of_nations_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_palace_of_nations_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_palace_of_nations_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_palace_of_nations_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_palace_of_nations_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_palace_of_nations_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_university_city_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_university_city
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_university_city_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_university_city_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_university_city_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_university_city_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_university_city_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_scholars_convocation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_public_lectures
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_collegiate_charter
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_university_city_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_university_city
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_university_city_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_university_city_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_university_city_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_university_city_decoration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_scholars_convocation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_public_lectures
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_collegiate_charter
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_university_city_expandable_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_scholars_convocation value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_scholars_convocation value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 10 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 10 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|10)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_scholars_convocation value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_scholars_convocation value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }

					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|10)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_collegiate_charter value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_collegiate_charter value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier

tv_wonder_location_has_university_city_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_university_city_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_university_city_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_university_city_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_university_city_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_university_city_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_sky_dome_grand_temple_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sky_dome_grand_temple
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sky_dome_grand_temple_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sky_dome_grand_temple_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sky_dome_grand_temple_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sky_dome_grand_temple_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_sky_dome_grand_temple_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_dome_consecration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_pilgrim_treasury
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_celestial_synod

			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_sky_dome_grand_temple_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_giant_tower_temple_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_tower_temple
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_tower_temple_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_tower_temple_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_tower_temple_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_tower_temple_decoration
	}
}

	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_beacon_rite_temple
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_pilgrim_stair_temple
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_temple_school_tower
	}

tv_wonder_location_has_giant_tower_temple_expandable_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_beacon_rite_temple value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_beacon_rite_temple value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 12 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 12 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|12)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_beacon_rite_temple value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_beacon_rite_temple value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 12 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 12 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|12)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_beacon_rite_temple value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_beacon_rite_temple value >= 4 } }
			OR = {

tv_wonder_location_has_giant_tower_temple_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_giant_tower_temple_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_giant_tower_temple_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_giant_tower_temple_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_giant_tower_temple_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_giant_tower_temple_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_river_extension_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_extension
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_extension_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_extension_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_extension_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_extension_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_river_extension_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_river_extension_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_extension
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_extension_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_extension_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_extension_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_extension_decoration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_bridge_opening
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority
	}
}

			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 13 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 13 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|13)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 13 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 13 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|13)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_river_extension_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_river_extension_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_river_extension_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_river_extension_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_river_extension_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_river_extension_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_national_shipyard_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_national_shipyard
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_national_shipyard_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_national_shipyard_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_national_shipyard_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_national_shipyard_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_national_shipyard_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_keel_laying_yard
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_fleet_muster_yard
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_admiralty_yard
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_national_shipyard_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_national_shipyard
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_national_shipyard_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_national_shipyard_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_national_shipyard_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_national_shipyard_decoration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_keel_laying_yard
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_fleet_muster_yard
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_admiralty_yard
	}

tv_wonder_location_has_national_shipyard_expandable_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_keel_laying_yard value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_keel_laying_yard value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 14 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 14 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|14)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_keel_laying_yard value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_keel_laying_yard value >= 3 } }

	tv_wonder_location_has_national_shipyard_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_national_shipyard_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_national_shipyard_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_national_shipyard_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_national_shipyard_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

	}

		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_siege_games_fortress value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_siege_games_fortress value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 15 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 15 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|15)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_siege_games_fortress value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_siege_games_fortress value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 15 } }

			}

			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_siege_games_fortress value >= 5 } }
			OR = {

				AND = {

tv_wonder_location_has_star_fortress_city_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_star_fortress_city_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_star_fortress_city_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_star_fortress_city_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_star_fortress_city_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_star_fortress_city_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_great_wall_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_wall
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_wall_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_wall_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_wall_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_wall_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_great_wall_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_frontier_muster_wall
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_signal_fires_wall
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_wall_oath
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_great_wall_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_wall
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_wall_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_wall_body

		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_wall_decoration

		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_signal_fires_wall
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_wall_oath
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_great_wall_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_great_wall_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_great_wall_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_great_wall_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_great_wall_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_great_wall_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_giant_armory_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_armory
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_armory_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_armory_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_armory_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_armory_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_giant_armory_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_foundry_contracts
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_master_armourers
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_giant_armory_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_armory
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_armory_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_armory_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_armory_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_armory_decoration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_foundry_contracts
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_master_armourers
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_giant_armory_expandable_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 17 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 17 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|17)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 17 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 17 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|17)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 17 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 17 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|17)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 17 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 17 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|17)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_muster_of_arms value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 17 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 17 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|17)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_foundry_contracts value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_foundry_contracts value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 17 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 17 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|17)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_foundry_contracts value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_foundry_contracts value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 17 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 17 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|17)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_foundry_contracts value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_foundry_contracts value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 17 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 17 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|17)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_foundry_contracts value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_foundry_contracts value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 17 } }

				AND = {

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|17)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_foundry_contracts value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_foundry_contracts value >= 6 } }
			OR = {

				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 17 } }
				}
				AND = {

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|17)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}

		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_master_armourers value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_master_armourers value >= 2 } }
			OR = {

				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 17 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 17 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|17)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_master_armourers value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_master_armourers value >= 3 } }

				AND = {

			}
		}
	}

tv_wonder_location_has_giant_armory_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_giant_armory_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_giant_armory_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_giant_armory_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_giant_armory_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_giant_armory_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_library_of_nation_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_library_of_nation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_library_of_nation_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_library_of_nation_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_library_of_nation_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_library_of_nation_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_library_of_nation_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_national_catalog_library
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_copyists_endowment_library
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_legal_deposit_library
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_library_of_nation_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_library_of_nation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_library_of_nation_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_library_of_nation_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_library_of_nation_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_library_of_nation_decoration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_national_catalog_library
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_copyists_endowment_library
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_legal_deposit_library
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_library_of_nation_expandable_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_national_catalog_library value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_national_catalog_library value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 18 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 18 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|18)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_national_catalog_library value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_national_catalog_library value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 18 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|18)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_national_catalog_library value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_national_catalog_library value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 18 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|18)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_national_catalog_library value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_national_catalog_library value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 18 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 18 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|18)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_national_catalog_library value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_national_catalog_library value >= 6 } }
			OR = {

				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier

				}

			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_copyists_endowment_library value >= 2 } }

			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_legal_deposit_library value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_legal_deposit_library value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 18 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 18 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|18)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_legal_deposit_library value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_legal_deposit_library value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 18 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 18 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|18)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_legal_deposit_library value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_legal_deposit_library value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 18 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 18 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|18)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_legal_deposit_library value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_legal_deposit_library value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 18 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|18)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_legal_deposit_library value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_legal_deposit_library value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 18 } }

				AND = {

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|18)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}

tv_wonder_location_has_library_of_nation_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_library_of_nation_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_library_of_nation_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_library_of_nation_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_library_of_nation_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_library_of_nation_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_large_canal_system_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_large_canal_system
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_large_canal_system_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_large_canal_system_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_large_canal_system_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_large_canal_system_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_large_canal_system_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_irrigation_canal_system
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_grain_transport_canal_system
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_flood_control_canal_system
	}
}

				}
			}

tv_wonder_location_has_mountain_terrace_network_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_mountain_terrace_network_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_mountain_terrace_network_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_mountain_terrace_network_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_mountain_terrace_network_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_mountain_terrace_network_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_giant_dam_project_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_dam_project
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_dam_project_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_dam_project_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_dam_project_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_dam_project_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_giant_dam_project_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_estuary_flood_dam
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_marsh_reclamation_dam
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_water_powered_workshops
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_giant_dam_project_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_dam_project
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_dam_project_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_dam_project_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_dam_project_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_dam_project_decoration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_estuary_flood_dam
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_marsh_reclamation_dam
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_water_powered_workshops
	}
}

			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_water_powered_workshops value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_water_powered_workshops value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 21 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 21 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|21)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_water_powered_workshops value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_water_powered_workshops value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 21 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|21)" ?= { this >= 6 }

tv_wonder_location_has_imperial_post_road_network_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_imperial_post_road_network_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_imperial_post_road_network_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_imperial_post_road_network_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_imperial_post_road_network_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_imperial_post_road_network_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_canal_hub_city_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_hub_city
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_hub_city_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_hub_city_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_hub_city_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_hub_city_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_canal_hub_city_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_grain_transport_hub
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_financial_warehouse_hub
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_industrial_workshop_belt
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_canal_hub_city_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_hub_city
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_hub_city_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_hub_city_body

		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_hub_city_decoration

		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_financial_warehouse_hub

	}
}

	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_frontier_colonization_belt_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_frontier_colonization_belt
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_frontier_colonization_belt_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_frontier_colonization_belt_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_frontier_colonization_belt_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_frontier_colonization_belt_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_frontier_colonization_belt_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_military_colony_belt
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_settler_reclamation_belt
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_religious_colonization_belt
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_frontier_colonization_belt_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_frontier_colonization_belt
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_frontier_colonization_belt_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_frontier_colonization_belt_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_frontier_colonization_belt_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_frontier_colonization_belt_decoration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_military_colony_belt
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_settler_reclamation_belt
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_religious_colonization_belt
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_frontier_colonization_belt_expandable_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_military_colony_belt value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_military_colony_belt value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|25)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_military_colony_belt value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_military_colony_belt value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|25)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_military_colony_belt value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_military_colony_belt value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|25)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_military_colony_belt value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_military_colony_belt value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|25)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_military_colony_belt value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_military_colony_belt value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|25)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_settler_reclamation_belt value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_settler_reclamation_belt value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|25)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_settler_reclamation_belt value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_settler_reclamation_belt value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|25)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_settler_reclamation_belt value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_settler_reclamation_belt value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|25)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_settler_reclamation_belt value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_settler_reclamation_belt value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|25)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_settler_reclamation_belt value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_settler_reclamation_belt value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|25)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_religious_colonization_belt value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_religious_colonization_belt value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|25)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_religious_colonization_belt value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_religious_colonization_belt value >= 3 } }

			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_religious_colonization_belt value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_religious_colonization_belt value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 25 } }

		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_religious_colonization_belt value >= 5 }

				AND = {

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|25)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

tv_wonder_location_has_frontier_colonization_belt_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_frontier_colonization_belt_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_frontier_colonization_belt_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_frontier_colonization_belt_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_frontier_colonization_belt_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_frontier_colonization_belt_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_coastal_beacon_network_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_coastal_beacon_network
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_coastal_beacon_network_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_coastal_beacon_network_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_coastal_beacon_network_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_coastal_beacon_network_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_coastal_beacon_network_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_beacon_communication_network
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_coastal_battery_network
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_customs_patrol_network
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_coastal_beacon_network_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_coastal_beacon_network
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_coastal_beacon_network_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_coastal_beacon_network_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_coastal_beacon_network_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_coastal_beacon_network_decoration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_beacon_communication_network
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_coastal_battery_network
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_customs_patrol_network
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_coastal_beacon_network_expandable_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_beacon_communication_network value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_beacon_communication_network value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 26 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 26 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|26)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_beacon_communication_network value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_beacon_communication_network value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 26 } }
				}

				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_beacon_communication_network value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_beacon_communication_network value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 26 } }
				}
				AND = {

				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_beacon_communication_network value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_beacon_communication_network value >= 5 } }
			OR = {

				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 26 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 26 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|26)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_beacon_communication_network value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_beacon_communication_network value >= 6 } }

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|26)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}

	tv_wonder_location_has_coastal_beacon_network_final_building_trigger = yes

}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_coastal_beacon_network_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_coastal_beacon_network_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_coastal_beacon_network_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_knightly_fortress_order_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_knightly_fortress_order
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_knightly_fortress_order_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_knightly_fortress_order_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_knightly_fortress_order_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_knightly_fortress_order_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_knightly_fortress_order_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_crusader_knightly_order
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_frontier_lord_order
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_mercenary_fortress_system
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_war_college_system_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_war_college_system_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_war_college_system_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_war_college_system_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_war_college_system_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_war_college_system_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_great_clock_bell_system_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_clock_bell_system
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_clock_bell_system_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_clock_bell_system_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_clock_bell_system_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_clock_bell_system_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_great_clock_bell_system_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_worship_clock_bells
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_curfew_clock_bells
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_astronomical_calendar_bells
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_great_clock_bell_system_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_clock_bell_system
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_clock_bell_system_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_clock_bell_system_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_clock_bell_system_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_clock_bell_system_decoration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_worship_clock_bells
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_curfew_clock_bells
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_astronomical_calendar_bells
	}
}
