					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 29 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 29 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|29)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_astronomical_calendar_bells value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_astronomical_calendar_bells value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 29 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 29 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|29)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_astronomical_calendar_bells value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_astronomical_calendar_bells value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 29 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 29 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|29)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_astronomical_calendar_bells value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_astronomical_calendar_bells value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 29 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|29)" ?= { this >= 6 }

	}

	tv_wonder_location_has_great_clock_bell_system_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_great_clock_bell_system_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_great_clock_bell_system_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_great_clock_bell_system_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_great_clock_bell_system_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_royal_art_district_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_art_district
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_art_district_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_art_district_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_art_district_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_art_district_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_royal_art_district_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_court_art_district
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_folk_art_district
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_foreign_style_district
	}
}

	OR = {

	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_royal_art_district_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_royal_art_district_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_royal_art_district_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_royal_art_district_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_grand_theater_festival_district_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_grand_theater_festival_district
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_grand_theater_festival_district_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_grand_theater_festival_district_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_grand_theater_festival_district_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_grand_theater_festival_district_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_grand_theater_festival_district_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_court_theater
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_religious_theater
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_popular_festival_ground
	}
}

	OR = {

	}

	OR = {
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_court_theater value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_court_theater value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 31 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 31 }

		AND = {

			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_court_theater value >= 3 } }

			OR = {

			OR = {

				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 31 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 31 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|31)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_court_theater value >= 5 }

tv_wonder_location_has_grand_theater_festival_district_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_grand_theater_festival_district_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_grand_theater_festival_district_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_grand_theater_festival_district_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_grand_theater_festival_district_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_grand_theater_festival_district_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_world_embassy_quarter_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_world_embassy_quarter
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_world_embassy_quarter_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_world_embassy_quarter_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_world_embassy_quarter_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_world_embassy_quarter_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_world_embassy_quarter_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_trade_diplomacy_embassies
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_intelligence_embassies
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_religious_diplomacy_embassies
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_world_embassy_quarter_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_world_embassy_quarter
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_world_embassy_quarter_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_world_embassy_quarter_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_world_embassy_quarter_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_world_embassy_quarter_decoration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_trade_diplomacy_embassies
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_intelligence_embassies
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_religious_diplomacy_embassies
	}
}

				AND = {

					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 32 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|32)" ?= { this >= 6 }

				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 34 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 34 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|34)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_grain_market value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_grain_market value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 34 } }

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|34)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_grain_market value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_grain_market value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier

		AND = {

			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_entrepot_market value >= 2 } }

tv_wonder_location_has_world_market_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_world_market_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_world_market_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_world_market_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_world_market_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_world_market_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_royal_mint_system_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_mint_system
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_mint_system_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_mint_system_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_mint_system_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_mint_system_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_royal_mint_system_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_silver_gold_standard_mint
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_copper_coinage_mint
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_international_settlement_mint
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_royal_mint_system_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_mint_system
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_mint_system_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_mint_system_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_mint_system_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_royal_mint_system_decoration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_silver_gold_standard_mint
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_copper_coinage_mint
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_international_settlement_mint
	}
}

	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_royal_mint_system_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_royal_mint_system_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_royal_mint_system_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_royal_mint_system_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_guild_alliance_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_guild_alliance
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_guild_alliance_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_guild_alliance_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_guild_alliance_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_guild_alliance_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_guild_alliance_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_artisan_guild_alliance
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_overseas_merchant_guilds
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_financial_guilds

tv_wonder_location_has_guild_alliance_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_guild_alliance_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_guild_alliance_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_guild_alliance_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_guild_alliance_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_guild_alliance_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_maritime_trade_station_network_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_maritime_trade_station_network
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_maritime_trade_station_network_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_maritime_trade_station_network_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_maritime_trade_station_network_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_maritime_trade_station_network_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_maritime_trade_station_network_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_spice_trade_stations
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_slave_trade_stations
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_colonial_supply_stations
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_maritime_trade_station_network_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_maritime_trade_station_network
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_maritime_trade_station_network_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_maritime_trade_station_network_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_maritime_trade_station_network_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_maritime_trade_station_network_decoration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_spice_trade_stations
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_slave_trade_stations
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_colonial_supply_stations
	}
}

				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 37 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 37 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|37)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_colonial_supply_stations value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_colonial_supply_stations value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 37 } }

				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_colonial_supply_stations value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_colonial_supply_stations value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 37 } }
				}
				AND = {

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|37)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {

			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_colonial_supply_stations value >= 5 } }
			OR = {

					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 37 } }

	tv_wonder_location_has_maritime_trade_station_network_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_maritime_trade_station_network_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_maritime_trade_station_network_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_maritime_trade_station_network_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_maritime_trade_station_network_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_giant_workshop_complex_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_workshop_complex
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_workshop_complex_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_workshop_complex_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_workshop_complex_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_workshop_complex_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_giant_workshop_complex_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_textile_workshop_complex
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_military_workshop_complex
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_luxury_craft_workshop_complex
	}

tv_wonder_location_has_world_monument_group_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_world_monument_group_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_world_monument_group_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_world_monument_group_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_world_monument_group_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_world_monument_group_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_city_expansion_project_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_city_expansion_project
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_city_expansion_project_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_city_expansion_project_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_city_expansion_project_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_city_expansion_project_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_city_expansion_project_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_city_charter
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_civic_grid
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_urban_renewal
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_city_expansion_project_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_city_expansion_project
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_city_expansion_project_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_city_expansion_project_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_city_expansion_project_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_city_expansion_project_decoration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_city_charter
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_civic_grid
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_urban_renewal
	}
}

					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 40 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 40 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|40)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_urban_renewal value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_urban_renewal value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 40 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 40 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|40)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	tv_wonder_location_has_city_expansion_project_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_city_expansion_project_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_city_expansion_project_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_city_expansion_project_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_city_expansion_project_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_megalithic_circle_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_megalithic_circle
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_megalithic_circle_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_megalithic_circle_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_megalithic_circle_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_megalithic_circle_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_megalithic_circle_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_astral_alignment_circle
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_ancestral_moot_circle
	}

		always = yes

			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_pilgrim_nave_cathedral value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_pilgrim_nave_cathedral value >= 3 } }

					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 42 }

			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_pilgrim_nave_cathedral value >= 3 }

tv_wonder_location_has_grand_cathedral_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_grand_cathedral_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_grand_cathedral_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_grand_cathedral_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_grand_cathedral_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_grand_cathedral_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_great_monastery_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_monastery
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_monastery_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_monastery_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_monastery_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_monastery_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_great_monastery_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_scriptorium_monastery
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_pilgrim_refectory_monastery
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_fortified_cloister_monastery
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_great_monastery_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_monastery
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_monastery_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_monastery_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_monastery_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_monastery_decoration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_scriptorium_monastery
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_pilgrim_refectory_monastery
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_fortified_cloister_monastery
	}
}

		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_decoration
	}
}

	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_inaugurated
	}
}

	OR = {

		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_function

		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_inaugurated
	}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_pharos_lighthouse_expandable_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_inaugurated value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 101 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 101 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|101)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_inaugurated value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 101 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 101 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|101)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_inaugurated value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 101 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 101 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|101)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_inaugurated value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 101 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 101 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|101)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_inaugurated value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_pharos_lighthouse_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 101 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 101 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|101)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	tv_wonder_location_has_unique_pharos_lighthouse_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_unique_pharos_lighthouse_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }

			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_angkor_wat_inaugurated value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_angkor_wat_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 104 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 104 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|104)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_angkor_wat_inaugurated value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_angkor_wat_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 104 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 104 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|104)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 108 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 108 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|108)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 108 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 108 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|108)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 108 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 108 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|108)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 108 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 108 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|108)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 108 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 108 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|108)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 111 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|111)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_peters_basilica_foundation

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_st_peters_basilica_expandable_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_peters_basilica_inaugurated value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_peters_basilica_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 112 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 112 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|112)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_peters_basilica_inaugurated value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_peters_basilica_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 112 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 112 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|112)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_peters_basilica_inaugurated value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_peters_basilica_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 112 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 112 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|112)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_peters_basilica_inaugurated value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_peters_basilica_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 112 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 112 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|112)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_peters_basilica_inaugurated value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_peters_basilica_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 112 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 112 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|112)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_malacca_port_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 115 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 115 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|115)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_malacca_port_inaugurated value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_malacca_port_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier

				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_malacca_port_inaugurated value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_malacca_port_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 115 } }
				}
				AND = {

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|115)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_malacca_port_inaugurated value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_malacca_port_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 115 } }

			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_red_fort_delhi_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }

					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 116 } }

		AND = {

			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_red_fort_delhi_inaugurated value >= 4 } }

			tv_wonder_location_has_unique_tenochtitlan_causeways_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_unique_tenochtitlan_causeways_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_final_building_trigger = {

	}
}

		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_decoration

	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_expandable_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_inaugurated value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 119 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 119 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|119)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_inaugurated value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 119 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 119 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|119)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_inaugurated value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 119 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 119 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|119)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_inaugurated value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 119 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 119 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|119)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_inaugurated value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 119 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 119 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|119)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	tv_wonder_location_has_unique_amsterdam_canal_ring_final_building_trigger = yes

		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_grand_canal_inaugurated
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_grand_canal_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_grand_canal
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_grand_canal_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_grand_canal_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_grand_canal_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_grand_canal_decoration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_grand_canal_inaugurated
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_grand_canal_expandable_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_grand_canal_inaugurated value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_grand_canal_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 126 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 126 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|126)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_grand_canal_inaugurated value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_grand_canal_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 126 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 126 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|126)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_grand_canal_inaugurated value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_grand_canal_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 126 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 126 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|126)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_grand_canal_inaugurated value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_grand_canal_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 126 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 126 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|126)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_grand_canal_inaugurated value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_grand_canal_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 126 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 126 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|126)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_grand_canal_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_unique_grand_canal_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_unique_grand_canal_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_unique_grand_canal_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_unique_grand_canal_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_unique_grand_canal_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

	OR = {
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_inca_royal_road_inaugurated value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_inca_royal_road_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier

		AND = {

			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_inca_royal_road_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
			OR = {

		AND = {

			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_inca_royal_road_inaugurated value >= 4 } }

			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_inca_royal_road_inaugurated value >= 5 } }

			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 129 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 129 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|129)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_suez_ancient_canal_inaugurated value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_suez_ancient_canal_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 129 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 129 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|129)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_kremlin_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_kremlin_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_inaugurated
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_kremlin_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_decoration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_inaugurated
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_kremlin_expandable_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_inaugurated value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 130 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 130 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|130)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_inaugurated value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 130 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 130 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|130)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_inaugurated value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 130 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 130 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|130)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_inaugurated value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 130 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 130 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|130)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_inaugurated value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 130 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 130 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|130)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_dutch_polders_expandable_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_dutch_polders_inaugurated value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_dutch_polders_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 133 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 133 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|133)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_dutch_polders_inaugurated value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_dutch_polders_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 133 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 133 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|133)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_dutch_polders_inaugurated value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_dutch_polders_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 133 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 133 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|133)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_dutch_polders_inaugurated value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_dutch_polders_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 133 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 133 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|133)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_dutch_polders_inaugurated value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_dutch_polders_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 133 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 133 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|133)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_unique_dutch_polders_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }

		always = yes
	}

		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_unique_dutch_polders_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 136 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 136 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|136)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_spanish_silver_fleet_inaugurated value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_spanish_silver_fleet_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 136 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 136 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|136)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	OR = {

			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_ottoman_hajj_road_inaugurated value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_ottoman_hajj_road_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 137 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 137 }

		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_ottoman_hajj_road_inaugurated value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_ottoman_hajj_road_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
			OR = {

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|137)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_ottoman_hajj_road_inaugurated value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_ottoman_hajj_road_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier

			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_ottoman_hajj_road_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
			OR = {

				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 137 } }
				}
				AND = {

			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_ottoman_hajj_road_inaugurated value >= 6 } }

			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_inaugurated value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 140 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 140 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|140)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_inaugurated value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_inaugurated value >= 3 } }

		}
		AND = {

			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
			OR = {

				AND = {

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|140)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_inaugurated value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 140 } }

				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_inaugurated value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
			OR = {

				AND = {

			tv_wonder_location_has_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }

		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_stonehenge_intermediate_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_stonehenge
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_stonehenge_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_stonehenge_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_stonehenge_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_stonehenge_decoration
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_stonehenge_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_stonehenge_inaugurated
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_stonehenge_project_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_stonehenge
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_stonehenge_foundation
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_stonehenge_body
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_stonehenge_function
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_stonehenge_decoration
		has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_stonehenge_inaugurated
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_stonehenge_expandable_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_stonehenge_inaugurated value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_stonehenge_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 141 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 141 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|141)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_stonehenge_inaugurated value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_stonehenge_inaugurated value >= 3 } }

				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_stonehenge_inaugurated value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_stonehenge_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
			OR = {

			OR = {

				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 143 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 143 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|143)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_st_basils_cathedral_expandable_final_building_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_basils_cathedral_inaugurated value >= 1 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_basils_cathedral_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 144 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 144 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|144)" ?= { this >= 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_basils_cathedral_inaugurated value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_basils_cathedral_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 144 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 144 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|144)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_basils_cathedral_inaugurated value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_basils_cathedral_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 144 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 144 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|144)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_basils_cathedral_inaugurated value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_basils_cathedral_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 144 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 144 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|144)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_basils_cathedral_inaugurated value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_st_basils_cathedral_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 144 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 144 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|144)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_gyeongbokgung_inaugurated value >= 2 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_gyeongbokgung_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 147 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 147 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|147)" ?= { this >= 3 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_gyeongbokgung_inaugurated value >= 3 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_gyeongbokgung_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 147 } }
				}
				AND = {

					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|147)" ?= { this >= 4 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_gyeongbokgung_inaugurated value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_gyeongbokgung_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 147 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 147 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|147)" ?= { this >= 5 }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_gyeongbokgung_inaugurated value >= 5 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_gyeongbokgung_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier }
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 147 } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = 147 }
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|147)" ?= { this >= 6 }
				}
			}
		}

tv_wonder_location_has_unique_meteora_monasteries_capped_final_building_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_location_has_unique_meteora_monasteries_final_building_trigger = yes
	NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_unique_meteora_monasteries_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_unique_meteora_monasteries_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_unique_meteora_monasteries_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_unique_meteora_monasteries_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_locked_wonder_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_location_has_locked_wonder_intermediate_building_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_locked_wonder_expandable_final_building_trigger = yes }
		always = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

tv_wonder_location_can_host_sacred_mountain_trigger = {
	OR = {
		tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_sacred_mountain_trigger = yes
		AND = {
			OR = {
				topography = mountains
				topography = plateau
				topography = hills
			}
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_sacred_mountain_capped_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_can_build_sacred_mountain_trigger = {
	any_owned_location = {
		tv_wonder_location_can_host_sacred_mountain_trigger = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_player_visible_site_rules_sacred_mountain_trigger = {
	any_owned_location = {
		OR = {
			topography = mountains
			topography = plateau
			topography = hills
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_can_host_triumphal_axis_trigger = {
	OR = {
		tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_triumphal_axis_trigger = yes
		AND = {
			OR = {
				location_rank ?= location_rank:city
				location_rank ?= location_rank:megalopolis
			}
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_triumphal_axis_capped_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_can_build_triumphal_axis_trigger = {
	any_owned_location = {
		tv_wonder_location_can_host_triumphal_axis_trigger = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_player_visible_site_rules_triumphal_axis_trigger = {
	any_owned_location = {
		OR = {
			location_rank ?= location_rank:city
			location_rank ?= location_rank:megalopolis
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_can_host_great_port_trigger = {
	OR = {
		tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_great_port_trigger = yes
		AND = {
			is_port = yes
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_great_port_capped_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_can_build_great_port_trigger = {
	any_owned_location = {
		tv_wonder_location_can_host_great_port_trigger = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_player_visible_site_rules_great_port_trigger = {
	any_owned_location = {
		is_port = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_can_host_giant_necropolis_trigger = {
	OR = {
		tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_giant_necropolis_trigger = yes
		AND = {
			location_rank ?= location_rank:rural_settlement
			NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_giant_necropolis_capped_final_building_trigger = yes }
		}
	}
