	any_owned_location = {
		tv_wonder_location_can_host_giant_necropolis_trigger = yes
	}

tv_wonder_player_visible_site_rules_giant_necropolis_trigger = {
	any_owned_location = {
		location_rank ?= location_rank:rural_settlement
	}
}

tv_wonder_location_can_host_great_lighthouse_trigger = {

tv_wonder_location_can_host_hydraulic_workshop_trigger = {
	OR = {
		tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_project_for_hydraulic_workshop_trigger = yes
		AND = {
			OR = {

		tv_wonder_location_can_host_royal_mint_system_trigger = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_player_visible_site_rules_royal_mint_system_trigger = {
	any_owned_location = {
		OR = {
			location_rank ?= location_rank:city
			location_rank ?= location_rank:megalopolis
			raw_material = goods:goods_gold
			raw_material = goods:silver
			raw_material = goods:copper
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_generic_has_any_feasible_proposal_trigger = {
	has_variable_map = tv_wonder_feasible_generic_deck
	any_key_in_variable_map = {
		variable = tv_wonder_feasible_generic_deck
		always = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_unique_has_any_feasible_proposal_trigger = {
	has_variable_map = tv_wonder_feasible_unique_deck
	any_key_in_variable_map = {
		variable = tv_wonder_feasible_unique_deck

	}

tv_wonder_selected_ritual_custom_confirmation_requirements_met_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_has_selected_ceremony_trigger = yes
	always = no
}

tv_wonder_selected_ritual_confirmation_requirements_met_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_has_selected_ceremony_trigger = yes
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_selected_ritual_has_confirmation_trigger
			var:tv_wonder_selected_ritual_has_confirmation_trigger ?= 1
		}
		tv_wonder_selected_ritual_custom_confirmation_requirements_met_trigger = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = yes }
}

tv_wonder_selected_ritual_monthly_listener_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_has_selected_ceremony_trigger = yes
	has_variable = tv_wonder_selected_ritual_listener_monthly
	var:tv_wonder_selected_ritual_listener_monthly ?= 1
}

	tv_wonder_has_selected_ceremony_trigger = yes
	has_variable = tv_wonder_selected_ritual_listener_ruler_death
	var:tv_wonder_selected_ritual_listener_ruler_death ?= 1
}

	var:tv_wonder_selected_ritual_listener_pre_winning_war ?= 1
}

tv_wonder_selected_ritual_ending_war_listener_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_has_selected_ceremony_trigger = yes
	has_variable = tv_wonder_selected_ritual_listener_ending_war
	var:tv_wonder_selected_ritual_listener_ending_war ?= 1
}

tv_wonder_selected_ritual_custom_completion_requirements_met_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_has_selected_ceremony_trigger = yes
	always = no
}

tv_wonder_selected_ritual_completion_requirements_met_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_has_selected_ceremony_trigger = yes
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_selected_ritual_has_custom_completion_trigger
			var:tv_wonder_selected_ritual_has_custom_completion_trigger ?= 1
		}
		tv_wonder_selected_ritual_custom_completion_requirements_met_trigger = yes
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_selected_generic_timed_ritual_trigger = yes }
		NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_timer }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_selected_generic_auxiliary_building_ritual_trigger = yes }
		has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished
	}
	trigger_else = { always = yes }
}

tv_wonder_ceremony_ready_for_confirmation_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_has_selected_ceremony_trigger = yes
	NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress }
	tv_wonder_selected_ritual_confirmation_requirements_met_trigger = yes
}

tv_wonder_ceremony_ready_for_free_confirmation_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_ceremony_ready_for_confirmation_trigger = yes
	OR = {
		AND = {
			tv_wonder_selected_generic_immediate_ritual_trigger = yes
			tv_wonder_selected_generic_no_decoration_cost_ritual_trigger = yes
		}
		tv_wonder_selected_generic_timed_ritual_trigger = yes
		tv_wonder_selected_generic_auxiliary_building_ritual_trigger = yes
		AND = {
			tv_wonder_selected_generic_artwork_decoration_ritual_trigger = yes
			tv_wonder_artwork_loss_agenda_available_trigger = yes
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_ceremony_ready_for_scaled_gold_confirmation_trigger = {
	tv_wonder_ceremony_ready_for_confirmation_trigger = yes
	tv_wonder_selected_generic_scaled_gold_decoration_ritual_trigger = yes
}

	tv_wonder_ceremony_ready_for_confirmation_trigger = yes
	tv_wonder_selected_generic_prestige_decoration_ritual_trigger = yes
}

	tv_wonder_has_locked_wonder_trigger = yes
	has_variable = tv_wonder_locked_is_unique
	var:tv_wonder_locked_is_unique ?= 1
}
